important_limitations: Only characters' explicit name and id fields from available card versions are covered; hidden aliases and relationships require manual review.
String mentions in historical story text cannot prove or disprove world overlap; names under 3 normalized codepoints omitted from text scan.
This review used public-to-repo Gold87/Gold108 and exposed Test20; the R45 frozen private Train/Val files were not independently compared.
Later-exported cards may contain state unavailable at some past source cutoff; reconstruct source-of-truth for each test case.
Raw source transcripts have not been screened for fuzzy scene/text duplicates and no new prompt-only independent Held-out has been received.
No text content, extracted names, secret keys or response mappings are included in this report.
